title: AMA Workflow Checkpoint
description: Persisted Cosmos document representing one MAF workflow checkpoint taken at an agent-step boundary. Backs FR-006, FR-007. Container TTL = 2,592,000 s (30 days), counted from the parent workflow_run.terminal_at (FR-012a).

run_id.description: Cosmos partition key; FK to workflow_runs.id.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing per run. Starts at 0. Unique per run_id.

step_name.description: Agent-step boundary at which the checkpoint was taken.

executor_states.description: Map of {executor_id: serialised state dict from on_checkpoint_save}. Opaque to the storage layer.

pending_requests.description: MAF-emitted pending RequestInfoEvent records (e.g., HITL approval requests) captured per MAF docs.

payload.description: Opaque MAF payload; for approval_request, this wraps the spec-008 ApprovalRequest envelope.
